title: David’s Song of Deliverance

questions.question: David spoke this song to the Lord when he was delivered from whom?
questions.explanation: 2 Samuel 22:1 (ESV): "...on the day when the LORD delivered him from the hand of all his enemies, and from the hand of Saul."

questions.question: What metaphor does David use for God in verse 2?
questions.explanation: 2 Samuel 22:2 (ESV): "The LORD is my rock and my fortress and my deliverer..."

questions.question: David said, "I call upon the LORD, who is worthy to be ______."
questions.explanation: 2 Samuel 22:4 (ESV): "I call upon the LORD, who is worthy to be praised..."

questions.question: What came out of God's mouth in David's description of His anger?
questions.explanation: 2 Samuel 22:9 (ESV): "...and devouring fire from his mouth..."

questions.question: Who is a rock, except our ______?
questions.explanation: 2 Samuel 22:32 (ESV): "For who is God, but the LORD? And who is a rock, except our God?"

questions.question: David said God makes his feet like the feet of a ______.
questions.explanation: 2 Samuel 22:34 (ESV): "He makes my feet like the feet of a deer..."

questions.question: What trains David's hands for war?
questions.explanation: 2 Samuel 22:35 (ESV): "He trains my hands for war, so that my arms can bend a bow of bronze."

questions.question: With the loyal God shows himself ______.
questions.explanation: 2 Samuel 22:26 (ESV): "With the merciful you show yourself merciful; with the blameless man you show yourself blameless" (ESV uses merciful/blameless/purified/tortuous, "loyal" is common translation for Hasid).

questions.question: God delivers David from the ______ people.
questions.explanation: 2 Samuel 22:44 (ESV): "You delivered me from strife with my people..." (NKJV: strivings of my people).

questions.question: This song is nearly identical to which Psalm?
questions.explanation: Psalm 18 is a near-duplicate of 2 Samuel 22.

questions.question: "He bowed the heavens and came down; ______ was under his feet."
questions.explanation: 2 Samuel 22:10 (ESV): "He bowed the heavens and came down; thick darkness was under his feet."

questions.question: On what did God ride and fly?
questions.explanation: 2 Samuel 22:11 (ESV): "He rode on a cherub and flew..."

questions.question: "With the crooked you show yourself ______."
questions.explanation: 2 Samuel 22:27 (ESV): "...with the crooked you make yourself seem tortuous."

questions.question: David said, "For by you I can run against a troop, and by my God I can ______."
questions.explanation: 2 Samuel 22:30 (ESV): "...and by my God I can leap over a wall."

questions.question: God is described as giving David the shield of His ______.
questions.explanation: 2 Samuel 22:36 (ESV): "You have given me the shield of your salvation..."

key_verse_text: This God—his way is perfect; the word of the LORD proves true; he is a shield for all those who take refuge in him. (ESV)
